headings.usage: Use Outfit for all section headers, app titles, and hero text to provide a modern, tech-forward feel.

body.usage: Use Inter for body text, developer names, app descriptions, and UI elements for maximum legibility.

instructions_to_main_agent: Perform a global find/replace across all components and CSS:
Ensure text contrasts against the new primary background by using #FFFFFF
Avoid completely transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, overlays, or sticky headers. Use solid white (#FFFFFF) or glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md) for clear visibility.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft, ambient shadows. App icons should have shadow-sm or shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)]. Featured banners can use shadow-lg.
visual_enhancers.radii: Prioritize rounded and pill shapes to mimic Play Store. App icons should be rounded-2xl. Buttons and chips should be rounded-full.
visual_enhancers.motion: Add subtle hover lifts to app cards: hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200. Buttons should have active:scale-95.

orbit_logomark.description: An 'Orbit' SVG logomark featuring a solid planet core and a tilted elliptical orbit ring, with a small satellite dot on the ring.
orbit_logomark.svg_markup: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 32 32" fill="none" width="32" height="32" class="text-primary"><circle cx="16" cy="16" r="6" fill="currentColor" /><ellipse cx="16" cy="16" rx="14" ry="5" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" transform="rotate(-30 16 16)" /><circle cx="28" cy="9" r="2.5" fill="currentColor" /></svg>
orbit_logomark.instructions_to_main_agent: Replace the existing plain 'B' square logo across the sidebar, header, and login hero with this SVG. On dark backgrounds, apply text-white to the SVG class. On light backgrounds, apply text-primary.

app_store_redesign.style: Google Play Store / Android App Store pattern.

components.header: Clean white sticky header (z-50) with the Orbit logo on the left, a pill-shaped gray search bar in the center (bg-zinc-100), and user profile on the right. Must not be transparent.
components.category_chips: Horizontal scrollable list of pill-shaped chips immediately below the header. E.g., 'For you', 'Top charts', 'Productivity', 'Games'. Classes: rounded-full px-4 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-200 whitespace-nowrap.
components.featured_hero: Large landscape banner card (max-w-5xl mx-auto). Large rounded corners (rounded-3xl). Image overlay with bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent. Bottom left should have App Icon, Title, Developer, and a bold pill-shaped 'Install' button.
components.horizontal_scroll_rows: Sections like 'Recommended for you' or 'New releases'. Title row with 'See all' arrow button. Content is a horizontal scrolling flex container (flex gap-4 overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory pb-4 hide-scrollbar).
components.app_cards:
Width fixed to w-[120px] or w-[140px] flex-shrink-0 snap-start. 
- Icon: w-full aspect-square rounded-2xl bg-zinc-100 shadow-sm overflow-hidden mb-2
- Title: text-sm font-medium text-zinc-900 truncate
- Developer: text-xs text-zinc-500 truncate
- Rating: flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-zinc-700 mt-1 (Include a 12px yellow star icon)

content_filtering.instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Remove any apps that belong to 'Pro', 'Lite', or 'SMS' categories from the 'My Apps' section and the public 'App Store' section mock data. Do not display them.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='install-app-button').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure sufficient contrast. Use APCA contrast checking if possible. Ensure text over images always has a gradient or scrim behind it for legibility.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic styling.
Do not apply 'transition: all' globally, as it breaks transforms.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate, ensuring solid text contrast.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react.
When customizing Shadcn components, ensure heights are flexible if content requires it (e.g., h-auto).
